text:
taylor: Quick heads-up — running into a last-minute availability issue. Caroline can't do the 10:00am PT RFC review tomorrow. She can either move to 2:00pm PT or swap with someone who can present at 10. Can we compress the meeting to 45m and reorder so the quick triage goes first? Please reply with swaps/claims. Pre-read: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ABC123 (please skim)

caroline: Ugh sorry team, family thing popped up. 2pm PT works for me but I know that's late for EU. If someone can take 10am I'd appreciate it. :pray:

jess: I can take Caroline's 10am slot and present section 2 + Qs. Happy to swap.

lin: I can also swap — I can move my item later and take 10am. 10am PT = 18:00 CET for me, still doable.

sam: I can cover reviewer notes for section 3. If we compress to 45m, suggest we cut deep design discussion and push that to a follow-up async doc.

taylor: Thanks — that's helpful. Proposed compact agenda if we move triage first: 5m triage, 25m author presentations (2 x 10 + 5 buffer), 10m reviewer notes/action items, 5m wrap. Does that work?

jess: Works for me. Can we make sure the calendar invite includes the latest deck + link to perf numbers? Also ping reviewers to skim pre-read (especially pages 4-7).

deploy-bot: calendar updated by @taylor — event "RFC review (compact)" — duration 45m — attendees updated.

taylor: Final agenda (will update invite unless someone objects):
```
1) Quick triage (5m) — taylor
2) Section A: authz pruning (10m) — lin
3) Section B: async cache policy (10m) — jess
4) Reviewer notes & actions (10m) — sam
5) Next steps / follow-ups (5m)
```
If no more swaps I'll lock the invite and mark pre-read required.

lin: Ack. Good plan.

caroline: Thanks all — if anyone needs me at 2pm I can still join, but 10am swap appreciated. Good luck! :smile:

sam: Also pinging @infra-team for the perf numbers link; if they can drop it in the thread that'd be great.

taylor: Cool — I'll mark the meeting "compact" and add the deck + perf link. Final call for swaps for 10 more minutes. :bell:
